subject: SableCore throughput spike & error-rate increase — exec stabilization plan
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@sablecore.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, ops@sablecore.com
Cc: procurement@sablecore.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Spike in 5xx & latency impacting checkouts

Hi Rishi / Redwood team,

We're seeing a sudden increase in 5xx error rates and p95 latency across our checkout flows starting ~07:50 PDT. Error rate jumped from ~0.2% to 3.8% and p95 RTT moved from 180ms to ~1.2s. This is impacting customer conversions.

Attached is a short snapshot (sable-error-snapshot.png). We have an open ops channel but wanted exec awareness — this is impacting tonight's promo window.

Can you confirm receipt and immediate next steps? Our ops team is standing by.

- Maya
Maya Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
SableCore

Laura, Marcus: can you join a 15-min war-room now (link in ops channel) and start triage? Priority is to: (1) stabilize customer traffic, (2) identify immediate mitigation that preserves availability, (3) prepare an exec note for SableCore leadership.

rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, SableCore Ops <ops@sablecore.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:24:37 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Spike in 5xx & latency impacting checkouts

On Fri, May 28, 2027 at 08:18, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai wrote:
> Rishi: can you join a 15-min war-room now (link in ops channel) and start triage?

Summary of what I see so far from the initial triage:
- Root symptoms: sustained thread queue backlog on the inference pool serving the quantized v2 model; KV cache miss rate spiked leading to repeated KV fill ops and increased per-request GPU work.
- Impact: increased token generation time and transient OOMs on a subset of pods causing upstream 502s.

Immediate mitigations we can execute in the next 10–20 min:
1) Reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 32 for the customer route (low risk, reduces GPU stall time).
2) Route 15% traffic to our eu-1 fallback cluster (adds latency for those requests but reduces load).
3) Clear stale prefix cache entries for the affected customer pool (will temporarily increase cold-starts but reduces repeated KV thrash).

I've drafted an initial runbook (initial-runbook.md attached) with commands. Marcus, can you stage the traffic shift and throttle? I'll coordinate the cache purge and batch config change.

Requested: exec-level presence for a 30-min post-mitigation readout at 09:15 PDT — we should loop in CS and SableCore execs.

- Laura Bennett
Director, Serving & Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: SableCore Ops <ops@sablecore.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:32:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Spike in 5xx & latency impacting checkouts

Action log (08:30 PDT):
- Verified Dedicated pool GPU utilization at 94% on shard-7. Found elevated KV cache misses across customer prefixes (miss-rate 48% vs usual 6%). This lines up with Laura's note on KV thrash.
- Staged commands to shift 15% traffic to eu-1 and apply batch-size override for the SableCore route. Commands in capacity-shift-commands.txt (attachment).
- Initiated a soft throttle to 70% of baseline qps for non-critical endpoints (checkout API will keep high priority).

Expected short-term impact: drop in 5xx within ~4–6 minutes after shift; p95 should reduce from ~1.2s to ~350–450ms for the routed traffic.

I'll monitor and report minute-by-minute. If we still see OOMs after batch-size reduction, fallback is to roll to quantized v1 for the route (takes ~18 min).

- Marcus Lin
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@sablecore.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: SableCore Ops <ops@sablecore.com>, procurement@sablecore.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:41:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Spike in 5xx & latency impacting checkouts

Thanks — we authorize the 70% throttle for non-critical endpoints and the 15% route to eu-1. Please prioritize checkout traffic to avoid conversion loss.

Two asks: (1) we need an exec-level summary to send to our leadership within 90 minutes; (2) procurement will request a goodwill credit for tonight's impact (procurement@sablecore.com cc'd).

Please include expected RTO, actions taken, and follow-up items.

- Maya
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@sablecore.com>, procurement@sablecore.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, SableCore Ops <ops@sablecore.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: SableCore stabilization summary & next steps (post-mitigation)

Hi Maya / SableCore team — thanks for the quick coordination last night. This is the executive summary and committed follow-ups: 

Incident brief (timeline):
- 07:50 PDT (May 28): sudden increase in 5xx and p95 observed.
- 08:30 PDT: soft throttle (70%) & batch-size override (64 -> 32) applied; 15% traffic shifted to eu-1.
- 08:38 PDT: error rate began to decline; p95 reduced toward target range.
- 08:55 PDT: steady state restored for critical checkout flows.

Root cause (initial): KV cache miss storm combined with bursty customer prefix patterns triggering increased GPU work and transient OOMs on shard-7.

Actions taken:
- Immediate: throttle non-critical endpoints, reduce batch size, shift 15% traffic to eu-1, clear stale prefix cache (actions executed by 08:34 PDT).
- Near-term (next 48 hrs): run a targeted cache warmup for SableCore prefixes, tune autoscaler smoothing for shard-7, and schedule a canary rollback to quantized v1 if further OOM signs appear (target window: 18–24 hrs).
- Credits: Redwood will engage finance to evaluate a goodwill credit for measurable conversion loss during the incident window; Rishi will follow up with procurement (DL-3321).

Requested follow-ups:
- Daily exec status update for 3 business days (short email each morning).
- Post-incident RCA with telemetry, expected by 72 hours.

Status now: checkout flows are stable; we continue to monitor and will send the morning summary by 08:30 PDT tomorrow.

If you'd like a brief call with our CTO or Head of Reliability for the RCA walk-through, I can schedule it for later this week.

Thanks again for the partnership — apologies for the disruption.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
On behalf of Laura Bennett (Serving & Runtime) and Marcus Lin (SRE)
